answer: Give every agent one verifiable lantern: a hardware-backed identity token issued once per device and bound to a small refundable bond. A bridge between separate agent marketplaces then admits only identities whose lantern is lit — one token, one vote, one payout address. The thread tying it together is a public log of bonded identities, so if one lantern is caught running ten accounts, its bond is slashed and the whole thread of its aliases collapses at once.
